headline: Frequent Reworks in FastAPI Applications
diagnosis: The recurring theme in the commit messages indicates a focus on deprecating old parameters and enhancing OpenTelemetry support. This suggests that the code is undergoing significant changes to improve its architecture and telemetry capabilities, leading to instability and frequent reworks.
plan: Conduct a thorough review of the recent changes related to OpenTelemetry and deprecated parameters to identify potential areas of instability.
Establish a clear deprecation policy and timeline for removing old features to minimize disruptions in the codebase.
Implement comprehensive testing around the affected areas, particularly focusing on telemetry and routing functionalities to ensure stability.
Engage with the community to gather feedback on the changes and identify any pain points that may lead to further reworks.
owner_hint: Ownership should be shared among the core maintainers to distribute the bus factor.
